messages:
maria_cs: Quick sync — BrightWave onboarding healthcheck. They hit the first 2 milestones but stalled on latency tuning during staging. want to align on SLOs before we share the formal report.

leah_pm: Noted. Are we still targeting the 99.95% uptime + p95 250ms SLO we discussed? customer asked for explicit credits language.

tom_eng: yes that's the internal target. For staging right now p95 is ~380ms under their load profile. investigating batching config and cache TTLs.

devon_se: @tom_eng can you share the staging perf logs? I can try a micro-batching patch that helped for NovaHealth.

ops_bot: deploy completed: feature/batching-experiment -> staging at 2026-03-18T09:22:11Z :white_check_mark:

tom_eng: deploying the micro-batch branch now to staging. will run 12-min ramp and post numbers.

maria_cs: Customer concern: their AM said "if latency doesn't improve by renewal review we'll need to re-evaluate." Renewal in 45 days. This is a potential risk flag.

aj_sales: Filing an internal renewal-risk note in Salesforce. @maria_cs can you confirm exact ask so I can include it in the renewal playbook?

maria_cs: They want: 1) clear SLOs in writing (uptime + p95), 2) monthly SLO report for next 6 months, 3) credit language for breach. Also want enablement session for their infra engineers.

nora_support: We can schedule a 60-min enablement next week. Suggested agenda: architecture overview, tuning knobs (batching, cache TTLs), and a quick runbook for debugging latency spikes.

leah_pm: For the SLO report: propose automated weekly CSV export + monthly executive summary. CSV columns: date, uptime_pct, p50_ms, p95_ms, error_rate, credits_applied.

maria_cs: Agree. We should also include our calculation snippet for credits. Draft: ```credit = round(max(0, (target_uptime - observed_uptime) / target_uptime) * monthly_fee, 2)``` include an example: target 99.95%, observed 99.80% -> credit = ((0.9995-0.9980)/0.9995)*$20k = ~$30.05 (approx).

devon_se: FYI the micro-batching patch moved p95 from 380ms -> 230ms in my quick run. result from staging run: p95 228ms, p50 70ms, error_rate 0.02%. I'll upload logs to the ticket.

maria_cs: Excellent. Next steps: 1) @tom_eng validate patch in a longer soak (48h) in staging, 2) @nora_support schedule enablement with BrightWave for next Tue/Thu slots, 3) @leah_pm assemble SLO + credit wording draft and push to their AM. I'll prep renewal risk brief for Sales.

aj_sales: Got it, I'll block renewal playbook update and cc customer success manager.

tom_eng: starting 48h soak now. will report back with final numbers and rollback plan if anything flakey shows.

maria_cs: Thanks all. If soak stays green, we'll offer the SLO report template + a 1-month performance improvement guarantee in the renewal terms to reduce churn risk.

leah_pm: I'll attach the report template and sample monthly executive summary by EOD tomorrow.

maria_cs: closing the loop here — will post a concise version of this thread in the renewal opportunity note and link to the staging perf artifacts. :thumbsup:
